summary: Created and executed a substantive desktop regression suite (Python + Node VM + Tk under Xvfb). 26/26 pytest passed and 5/5 extension background.js VM tests passed.
action_items: Run Windows-only validation still pending: RegisterHotKey with real Win32, autostart shortcut behavior, registry native-host install/remove, League lockfile discovery on real client restarts.
Run real browser integration on Windows (Chrome/Edge/Firefox profiles) to confirm native messaging registration/signing constraints and manual extension lifecycle.
Validate Defender/SmartScreen behavior and quarantine history on target user machine; cannot be proven in Linux container.
critical_code_review_comments: No functional failures detected in tested desktop modules (storage/hotkeys/URL/selection/LCU/bridge/protocol/UI) under mocked transports and Xvfb UI run.
Coverage of Chromium/Firefox extension logic now exists via VM harness against production extension/shared/background.js, including dedupe, ACK-before-close, and session ownership restore behavior.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Tests used temporary directories and in-memory/fake transports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Node tests were executed via: node --test /app/autopicker/tests/test_extension_background.js. Python tests via DISPLAY=:99 Xvfb and pytest with JUnit output. Screenshot captured at /app/test_reports/ui_tk_desktop.png.
rca_of_issue: No blocking defects reproduced in this environment. Remaining risk is environment gap: Windows-only and real League/browser policy behavior cannot be verified from Linux container.
